notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Felhide Spiritbinder.
Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Activate Freed from the Real's first ability by paying {U}, tapping Felhide Spiritbinder.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Felhide Spiritbinder.
Felhide Spiritbinder triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R} to create a token copy of Dockside Extortionist with haste.
The token Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}{U}{R}.
Repeat.
